introduction: It is not common knowledge to replace the filter in a fan coil system despite the fact that it may seem so to others. This guide will ensure that you are able to replace the existing filter in your fan coil system in a quick and effective manner. People will spend money to have someone come in and repair their fan coil due to damage caused by dust and residue build-up on the filter. Meanwhile, this damage can be avoided altogether by regular filter changes. A fan coil filter should be replaced every 2-3 months to ensure clean air quality in the household.

instructions: If you aren't sure if the filter is ready to be changed just remember this is what cleans the air you are breathing.
Never wash or reuse a disposable filter

Pleated filters remove more dirt from the air than fiberglass filters. But their density restricts the air flow more. This can create problems in some systems. Experiment with both and see which is best for you and your system.
Filters should be checked every 30 days on residential applications and every 15 days on commercial applications.
